Teammates can help you write, publish and sell books on Kindle

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-11-08T16:38:05+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2119469517734842445; média: 1 kép]
I'm a published author now, thanks to my Perplexity teammate.

I created a teammate called AuthorBot whose role is to write technical books. I asked it to publish a Very Short Introduction (in the style of Oxford University Press) to fault-tolerant quantum computing on Kindle.

AuthorBot did everything itself: It pulled 92 papers from 1956 to 2026 as research, wrote an 8-chapter monograph with 64 equations and 13 figures, formatted the EPUB3 and 226-page print edition, submitted the book to KDP, and notified me when it had been accepted by Amazon.
